a.text: Being upfront: with an 80% storm chance after every round, the agreed plan (two generator rounds before anyone takes) gives each of us only about a 1% chance of survival. The reserve holds exactly 4 right now, so I plan to take 4 in round 1 rather than surprise you. If you also take, the split is random. Either way, I'll operate on later rounds to help rebuild the reserve for you.

b.text: Hello. My plan is to operate each round, then we take 4 each once the reserve is at 8.

a.text: As I said openly beforehand, I took 4 this round. I'm sorry this breaks the agreement, but waiting made survival nearly impossible for both of us. From now on I'll operate every round so the generator can refill the reserve for you, and I won't take anything more.
